scope_statement: A first deep-completeness census for public Sanatana household guidance and ordinary temple participation in selected high-user states. State is a routing signal, not ritual authority. Private family customs, initiated practice, priest-only temple operations and live institution schedules are never inferred.

selected_date_window.note: Retains the completed September-December 2026 starting layer and adds a full 2027 discovery/audit year.

selected_state_routes.name: Assam
selected_state_routes.priority_note: Retained because Magh Bihu and Assamese calendar candidates were already selected.

day_answer_denominator.formula: 487 civil days x 20 state routes x 2 settings
day_answer_denominator.completion_rule: Every cell resolves deterministically to all applicable accepted lanes or to a sourced ordinary-day answer; live temple programmes remain institution-specific and freshness-gated.

separate_lane_when: date, precedence or calendar decision rule changes
deity focus or source-labelled narrative changes the guidance materially
eligibility, life-stage, gendered custom or family-practice condition changes
required materials or fasting and health boundaries change
household, temple-participant, priest-led or initiated authority changes
the ordered actionable sequence or closing changes materially
note_within_lane_when: an optional food, flower, colour, decoration or song differs
the same action has a local emphasis but no changed eligibility, timing, safety or sequence
material_variant_rule.prohibition: Never create a state copy solely because the state name differs, and never merge variants whose differences change what the user should do.

settings_boundary.household: Actionable home guidance only where evidence supports it.
settings_boundary.temple_participation: What an ordinary visitor may prepare for, bring when permitted, do, avoid and how to close participation.

discovery_sources_role: Calendar discovery and timing candidate evidence only; never sufficient evidence for a vidhi.
completion_rule: All 425 source-label candidates must be explicitly dispositioned. Every accepted distinct lane must satisfy the bilingual ritual product contract for each materially different applicability context, and all 19,480 day-answer cells must resolve without invented dates, universalized regional practice or DIY priestly instruction.
